verdict.rationale: Mercury documents interest-earning options: savings accounts, "up to 3.89% yield with Treasury by Mercury Advisory", and internal transfers into treasury accounts. Nothing in the evidence shows balances held in currencies other than USD, let alone interest on them; the only currency-specific claim is about USD payments. missing for 10: evidence of multi-currency account balances, evidence of yield on non-USD holdings, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the treasury yield.
